results.title: Del Mundo
results.overview: This biographical documentary honors Doy del Mundo’s lifelong devotion to education, film, and public service; his pioneering role in shaping Philippine film education; and his enduring impact on institutions and generations he helped build and uplift.

results.title: Arrebol
results.overview: A vampire desperately searches for the records of his existence after learning of the passing of the artist who painted his portrait.

results.title: Laundry Day
results.overview: A woman has a treasured item stolen from the laundromat

results.title: Agak Laen: Menyala Pantiku!
results.overview: After repeatedly failing their missions, Detectives Bene, Boris, Jegel, and Oki are given one last chance: to go undercover in a nursing home in search of a fugitive wanted for the murder of the mayor’s child.

results.title: All the Empty Rooms
results.overview: A journalist and a photographer set out to memorialize the bedrooms left behind by children killed in school shootings.

results.title: Peter Hujar's Day
results.overview: A recently discovered conversation between photographer Peter Hujar and his friend Linda Rosenkrantz in 1974 reveals a glimpse into New York City’s downtown art scene and the personal struggles and epiphanies that define an artist’s life.

results.title: 100 Nights of Hero
results.overview: When a charming house guest arrives at a remote castle, the delicate dynamic between a neglectful husband, his innocent bride Cherry and their devoted maid Hero is thrown into chaos.

results.title: Visualizer
results.overview: Rising musician, Harry Wright, wishes to create a music video for his recently released debut single with the most popular kid in his high school, Aiden Parker, and although things don't go as planned, they must learn that all art is worth celebrating.

results.title: Кошка мышка
results.overview: A girl and a man lead each other by the nose without saying a word.

results.title: Adiós
results.overview: During a hunting day in rural Spain, a father struggles to accept that his adult son is moving abroad, dealing with the feelings of being left alone.

results.title: Smoke Signs
results.overview: A top-secret dispensary from Malibu psycho-actively breeds cannabis. A man uses weed to enhance his inner vision, looks for work.

results.title: Jaat
results.overview: A mysterious stranger journeys to a remote town controlled by a callous crime lord, with one violent mission — restoring justice to its people.

results.title: Hallow Road
results.overview: Two parents enter a race against time when they receive a distressing late-night phone call from their daughter after she caused a tragic car accident.

results.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part I)
results.overview: After reclaiming Kaamelott from Lancelot's tyrannical rule, Arthur spares his life, defying Celtic gods. Knights must prove themselves for Table Round seats while Arthur faces new threats as king.

results.title: Shadowlands
results.overview: Shadowlands is an anthology series that explores love in three distinct stories: a couple renegotiating a relationship, a narcissist seeking to understand it, and star-crossed lovers mourning its loss.

results.title: Spit
results.overview: Spitteri finds himself locked up in an immigration detention centre upon his return to Australia. With old enemies on his tail and a target on his back, he navigates a series of comedic misadventures, sharing with his fellow detainees the meaning of mateship and what it is to be truly Australian.

results.title: The Boundary
results.overview: Transform the object of manipulation into a part of your creative expression.

results.title: Wall to Wall
results.overview: A man who poured his life savings into a new apartment discovers its walls are full of disturbing noises, hostile neighbors and unsettling secrets.

results.title: The Age of Disclosure
results.overview: Director Dan Farah got 34 senior members of the U.S. Government, military, and intelligence community to come on camera. He says they reveal an 80 year cover-up of the existence of non-human intelligent life and a secret war amongst major nations to reverse engineer technology of non-human origin. The film explores the profound impact the situation has on the future of humanity, while providing a look behind-the-scenes with those at the forefront of the bi-partisan disclosure effort.
